_comment: Deterministic user-facing templates emitted by the English pipeline. {0},{1},... are protected values (report names, dates, numbers, acronyms) captured from the live response and re-inserted verbatim - never translated. This file is the MATCHING side: each value must equal the English the pipeline actually produces, or the entry stops matching and the text falls through to the runtime translator. backend/tests/test_i18n_catalogue.py enforces that.
